Analyzing a function definition analyzes the body of the function only once.
	The execution function creates the function object in
	the environment that it is called with, and assigns it to the name.

def analyze_function_definition(component):
    symbol = function_definition_symbol(component)
    params = function_definition_parameter_symbols(component)
    bfun = analyze_function_body(params, function_definition_body(component))
    def the_definition(env):
        assign_symbol_value(symbol, make_function(params, bfun, env), env)
        return None
    return the_definition

For return statements, we analyze the return expression.
	The execution function for the return statement simply calls
	the execution function for the return expression and wraps
	the result in a return value.

def analyze_assignment(component):
    symbol = assignment_symbol(component)
    vfun = analyze(assignment_value_expression(component))
    def the_assignment(env):
        value = vfun(env)
        assign_symbol_value(symbol, value, env)
        return value
    return the_assignment
